hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|]|[[:space:]])rm([[:space:]]|$)' && printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q 'data/'; then jq -n --arg reason "Blocked: this Bash command runs rm and references data/, which holds hand-curated SQLite state (e.g. data/saved-areas.db) that is not fully rebuildable from code. Inspect the file (e.g. sqlite3 <file> 'select count(*) from <table>') and confirm with the user before deleting anything there; prefer moving it aside (mv to a scratch dir) over rm." '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$reason}}'; fi
